title: Roblox Doors Open Door
blurb: A creak, a swing, and then the small dread of not knowing what waits on the other side. Opening doors is the core verb of the biggest horror game on Roblox, and LSPLASH made the sound deliberately unhurried so your brain has time to fill the gap with something awful. Most of the time it is an empty room. Players still flinch. Away from the game the clip works as a plain door effect, which is why it turns up in edits with no connection to Roblox at all.
origin: The door opening sound from Roblox Doors.
